# SprintTrack

> SprintTrack (AI Sprint Coach) is an iOS app for sprinters: periodized training, nutrition, PR tracking, and weekly Film Room video form analysis.

Site: https://sprinttrack.app
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sprinttrack-ai-sprint-coach/id6762912944

## Key pages
- Home: https://sprinttrack.app/
- Blog index: https://sprinttrack.app/blog/
- Privacy: https://sprinttrack.app/privacy-policy.html
- Terms: https://sprinttrack.app/terms-of-service.html
